model_rule: All numeric clock observations are prereace evidence only, not approved formal ⑦ weighting. Unobserved ⑦ must be marked 根拠未取得 or 未観測の仮置き, never a proven negative B−. No mark/probability/final_bets changes from these clocks without separately approved validity.
prohibited_actions_unchanged: No E0/E1/E2 research, no PR #86, no Shadow or research-workflow dispatch; no historical predictions, PDF, odds or bets changed.
source_limits: Final workout only; missing 6F or 5F cells are absent and NOT inferred from 4F. 7F never substituted for 6F. Tokyo source did not specify track going in the selected displayed clock.
